Card Q&A.a: No. So long as you had 3 or more security cards at the time you activated this card’s inherited effect, the -2000 DP will persist until the end of the turn, even if you end up with 2 or fewer security cards.
Card Q&A.q: An opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP from this card's inherited effect. During the same turn, I end up with 2 or fewer cards in my security stack. Does the -2000 DP granted by this card’s inherited effect go away?

Inherited Effect: [When Attacking][Once Per Turn] If you have 3 or more security cards, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.
